questions: Did the dark discoloration or facial puffiness begin suddenly?
Have you had any recent injury to your head, face, or nose?
Do you currently have severe headache, eye pain, or facial pain?
Have you noticed any loss of vision, blurred vision, or double vision?
Have you noticed unequal pupils, drooping of an eyelid, or a new change in your eye movements?
Have you had weakness, numbness, trouble speaking, confusion, fainting, or difficulty walking?
Do you have fever, marked redness around either eye, or pain when moving your eyes?
Do you have nasal congestion, sneezing, itchy or watery eyes, or frequent rubbing of your eyes?
Is the puffiness worse in the morning or after lying down?
Do you have shortness of breath, wheezing, swelling of your lips or tongue, or trouble swallowing?
Have you had unexplained weight gain, easy bruising, muscle weakness, or new high blood pressure?
Have you recently started any new medicines, creams, supplements, or recreational drugs?
Has the raised spot beside your nostril recently grown, bled, crusted, or become painful?
